review.method: all contact-sheet frames reviewed; idle, aim, magazine, swap inspected at full resolution
review.scope: AK47 first-person action capture at 5 fps; local two-player PIE idle views
limitations: 5 fps review cannot prove every interpolated frame
third-person original retargeted actions retained by agreement
criteria: complete sleeves without visible cut openings
hands do not obstruct the sight line
magazine follows hand during removal and returns to bind pose
actual imported reload and equip montages remain active
switching view resumes action and restores render flags
first-person shading no longer alternates with world-body shadow
both PIE views show the other complete character and local arms only
AK front post sits in rear sight notch near screen center; stock and hands do not hide it
